assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness consistent with supraventricular tachycardia
The patient presents with transient neurological symptoms suggestive of a transient cerebral ischemic attack
The diagnosis of supraventricular tachycardia is coded as I47.1
The diagnosis of transient cerebral ischemic attack is coded as G45.9
Mobile cardiac telemetry is coded with CPT 93229
The service is ordered to correlate intermittent arrhythmic events with clinical symptoms and assess for potential embolic sources or hemodynamic instability
The appeal addresses a medical necessity denial under Reason Code PR-204
